exceptions.reason: This chart's categories run DOWN the plot, so the cursor answers ArrowUp and ArrowDown and leaves the horizontal pair alone. The pattern names both pairs because which one walks the categories is a property of the chart rather than of the pattern, and answering all four would consume a key this chart has no sequence for.

additions.reason: The plot is one keyboard region and the data cursor rides inside it: the group carries tabindex="0", role="group" and the chart name, and ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End and Escape move a cursor that drives exactly what hover drives. The cursor walks BANDS rather than bars, so one press reads both sides of the centre at once, which is the comparison this chart exists to make and the one a per-bar cursor would take two presses to state.
